experiment: Exp T8 (Q31 + Q34): Cloud-Masked Opposite-Face Stroke-Bounded TFCE Rescue on Real argus-v3 & reader-v3 Ink Maps

prob_opp_provenance.assumption_disclosure: Public S3 argus-v3 and reader-v3 TIFFs are single-face ink probability maps with no paired opposite-face (desc) TIFF published on S3. prob_opp is constructed deterministically by tiling the lowest-activity real off-text 512x512 margin tiles from the same map with D4 dihedral transforms, preserving true papyrus baseline floor, spatial weave autocorrelation, and realistic min(prob_dom, prob_opp) null behavior.
